title: wow-cli recipients
description: List of users authorized to decrypt the wow encrypted manifest. Each entry pairs an age X25519 recipient (public key) with a human-readable name. The wow build-manifest command reads this file and encrypts the manifest to every listed key; revoking a user is removing their entry and republishing.

$schema.description: URI of the schema this file conforms to (used by editors).

name.description: Human-readable label for the holder of this key (e.g. "alice", "ci-bot").

key.description: age X25519 recipient public key, generated via `wow keygen`.

note.description: Optional free-form context (device, date added, etc).
